profile.summaryJa: 現在のギリシア領クレタ島。島全体の地名として扱い、特定の港や寄港地と同一視しない。使徒27:7では、船が島の風下を航行した。
profile.modernLocationJa: 現在のギリシア領クレタ島。
profile.historicalRoleJa: 使徒27:7で船が島の風下を航行した。
profile.locationNoteJa: 候補座標は未採用。地理記述は概略に留め、Pleiades公式固定データまたは考古学機関でこの対象を照合できていないため座標はnull。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: When we had sailed slowly many days, and had come with difficulty opposite Cnidus, the wind not allowing us further, we sailed under the lee of Crete, opposite Salmone.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: WEB固定版の使徒27:7で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: When we had sailed slowly many days, and had come with difficulty opposite Cnidus, the wind not allowing us further, we sailed under the lee of Crete, opposite Salmone.

WEB固定版の使徒27:12で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: Because the haven was not suitable to winter in, the majority advised going to sea from there, if by any means they could reach Phoenix and winter there, which is a port of Crete, looking southwest and northwest.
WEB固定版の使徒27:13で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: When the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, they weighed anchor and sailed along Crete, close to shore.

WEB固定版の使徒27:21で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: When they had been long without food, Paul stood up in the middle of them and said, “Sirs, you should have listened to me, and not have set sail from Crete and have gotten this injury and loss.
